description: This file defines the class Kint_Decorators_Rich, which provides static methods for decorating and rendering debug information, including variable display, trace visualization, and HTML wrapping, for the Kint debugging tool.

classes.name: Kint_Decorators_Rich
classes.description: A class providing static methods to decorate and render variable data and traces for the Kint debugger, including HTML output and trace visualization.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Generates HTML to visually decorate a variable, including its extended values and alternatives.

methods.name: decorateTrace
methods.description: Creates HTML for a visual representation of a stack trace.

methods.name: wrapStart
methods.description: Begins the HTML output for a Kint dump.

methods.name: wrapEnd
methods.description: Closes the HTML container for a Kint dump and adds caller information.

methods.name: _drawHeader
methods.description: Constructs the header portion of a variable display, including type, name, and access modifiers.

methods.name: _ideLink
methods.description: Creates a hyperlink to the file in an IDE or a full path if links are not available.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Produces necessary CSS and JS for Kint's display, designed to be included in HTML output.
